newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnlines joins Helsinki's top-20 index.
newsitem.headline: Finnlines joins Helsinki's top-20 index.

text.p: Shipping company Finnlines will join the list of the Helsinki Stock Exchange's 20 most traded shares, replacing steel group Rautaruukki Oy's K share in the HEX-20 index, the bourse said in a statement on Tuesday.
The HEX-20 index is made up of the twenty most actively traded shares over the past 12 months, a narrower measure of performance than the bourse's main all-share HEX index.
The shares in the HEX-20 index are revised twice a year. Only one share per company is allowed on the list.
From January 1 to June 30, 1997, the HEX-20 index will comprise the following shares:

Nokia A, UPM-Kymmene, Merita A, Raision Tehtaat, Valmet A, Kesko, Vakuutusosakeyhtio Sampo A, Amer-yhtyma, Huhtamaki I, Outokumpu A, Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola B, Kemira, Enso R, Metra B, Metsa-Serla B, Orion-yhtyma B, Finnlines, Rauma, Tamro and Cultor 2.
